args: PID=$$; while [ "$PID" -ne 1 ]; do if hyprctl clients -j | jq -e --argjson pid "$PID" '.[] | select(.pid == $pid)' >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi; PID=$(ps -o ppid= -p "$PID" | tr -d ' '); done; WS=$(hyprctl clients -j | jq -r --argjson pid "$PID" '.[] | select(.pid == $pid) | .workspace.name // .workspace.id'); test "{event}" != subagent_complete && notify-send -a opencode -u low "[WS${WS}] $(basename "$PWD")" "{message}"
